summary: Eps 46-61 (1999) adapt chs 64-98 nearly linearly at ~2 chs/episode: Whale Island interlude (46-49, chs 64-69), departure and Yorknew setup (50-52, chs 70-74), Uvogin vs Shadow Beasts/Kurapika (53-56, chs 75-84), Greed Island money hunt and Troupe capture (57-59, chs 85-93), and the hostage night through Zeno/Silva vs Chrollo setup (60-61, chs 94-98 p.13). Hunterpedia's page-level 'Adapted' fields cover every episode and its chapter pages' reverse maps agree throughout except one off-by-one (Chapter 74 page says ep 53; episode fields plus both Wikipedia synopses put the ch 73-74 auction massacre in ep 52 'Annihilation x Machinegun' — resolved to ep 52). The Uvogin fight is stretched with overlapping page splits (77 p.1-6 previewed in ep 53 then re-adapted in ep 54; 79 and 80 split three ways across 54-56). Ch 72 p.1-3 is pre-grafted into ep 50, and ch 83 (partly pre-grafted into ep 45 per the stored annotation) is adapted in mainline position in ep 56. The new range dovetails exactly with stored anchors on both sides: ep 45 continue->64 and ep 62 start=98 {98 p.13-19}. Independent boundary corroboration: fan comparison blog gives 1999 eps 48-57 = chs 67-88 and eps 58+ = chs 89+, matching exactly.
